spans.s:
छटा छटा, f. a mass, lump, assemblage,
number; a collection of rays of light, light, lustre,
splendor; a straight or continuous line; [cf. जटा.]
—छटा-फल, अस्, m. the betel-nut tree, palmyra
tree.
—छटाभा (˚टा-आभा), f. lightning.

छाटा छाटा, f. title of a commentary on
the Mugdha-bodha; [cf. छटा.]
